criteria.notes: The fixed 1920x1080 screen includes the requested editable exhibition content, optional media, coordinated colors, transparency, and visibility controls without dashboard chrome or pagination.
The supplied poster remains recognizable through the vermilion title field, cobalt welcome band, yellow information field, concentric aperture, serif contrast, and asymmetric negative space.
Oversized stacked type, sharp primary-color geometry, and the fictional kinetic-sculpture aperture create a museum-specific poster rather than a generic interface layout.
Welcome, exhibition title, venue, subtitle, and date retain a clear viewing-distance hierarchy across default and stress states.
Light, custom, and transparent-background renders preserve readable ink on every color field; custom primary metadata resolves to a contrasting color.
The long title remains complete in whole-word lines at signage scale; the four-line subtitle and stressed venue/date labels remain intact and above their declared floors.
Every state retains the fixed poster geometry with contained overflow; hidden metadata collapses without orphan rules, and negative space remains deliberate.
The fictional sculpture image is cleanly cropped inside the ring, hidden or broken media resolves to the geometric fallback, and editor artwork is app-specific.
The reference-led poster fields, circular aperture, and typography avoid repository examples' dashboard, card, header, and standard pagination patterns.

screenshots.notes: Inspected at 1920x1080; title, media, metadata, rule, and edge spacing are balanced and fully legible.
Custom charcoal, coral, ivory, and mint fields remain coordinated with strong text contrast.
Unusable media resolves to the complete concentric motif with no broken icon, empty aperture, or layout shift.
The complete long title forms six intentional whole-word lines while subtitle, venue, and date remain readable and unclipped.
Venue, subtitle, date, image, and dependent rule collapse cleanly; the retained geometric mark balances the open yellow field.
The circular aperture becomes the reference-matched black and cream motif while all exhibition copy and panel geometry remain unchanged.
The checkerboard is visible only through the transparent neutral field; colored panels, ring, media, and text remain coherent and readable.
